scope: Independent review of the supplied design reference and rendered front head portraits
earlier_finding: The happy cheek lift was hard to see. The surprised eye showed a second pale rim.

final.neutral: PASS. Head shape, brown eyes, small nose and resting mouth preserve the base identity.
final.happy: PASS. The raised lower lids, broad warm cheeks, closed arcs and smile read together. The original socket perimeter remains faintly visible at portrait size.
final.surprised: PASS. The raised lid line, wider whites, smaller pupils and O mouth read clearly. The inner rim is less apparent.
final.sad: PASS. The outer brows and lids droop, and the mouth corners turn down.
final.sheet: PASS. All four front views are framed consistently and labelled.
